description: Find campgrounds within a radius of a coordinate across federal, state and private land, with whether each is reservable and a booking link. Call this when someone asks where to camp near a place. Returns the campground's own page so conditions and site detail can be read next.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles. Defaults to 25, max 100.

reservable_only.description: Only campgrounds that take reservations. Defaults to false, which also returns first-come sites.

name: find_campgrounds
title: Campgrounds near a coordinate
